01 — Context

The Challenge

Although bottlers were actively promoting the app and encouraging merchandisers to install it, user engagement remained critically low despite the app's clear benefits. The business was struggling to manage merchandising across remote European locations — directly impacting approximately 5% of sales.

01

Low user engagement despite active promotion by bottlers and clear reward incentives

02

Inability to manage merchandising across remote locations — ~5% sales impact

03

Unclear instructions and opaque scoring system causing user frustration and drop-off

02 — Discovery

Research Approach

Real users were store owners and merchandisers in remote European locations. In-person testing wasn't possible, so we set up remote usability sessions over Microsoft Teams — recording each call while participants used the app live on their own devices.

Each session covered 5 tasks and ran 30–40 minutes with 5 users. We measured task success rate, time on task, total clicks, and System Usability Scale (SUS) score.

Tasks assigned: Sign Up · Capture Scene & Submit · Check Best Result & Return to Home · Update Profile · Check Result Image & SKU Tab

03 — Usability Testing

Usability Test Metrics

All values are averages across 5 users. SUS scores above 80 are considered good; below 60 indicate significant usability problems.

Capture Scene & Submit80%5 min1276
Check Best Result & Go to Home60%4 min662

Check Result Image & SKU Tab40%5 min2038

The Check Result Image & SKU Tab task had a 40% success rate and SUS 38 — well below acceptable threshold. This became the primary redesign focus.

04 — Qualitative Research

User Interviews

We interviewed 3 users in depth to understand their daily context, motivations, and frustrations. Common patterns emerged around clarity of instructions, scoring transparency, and reward accessibility.

U1
User 1 — Frequent Rewards App User Power User ▾
Experience

Heard about the app from a friend. Opens it while out to capture assets. Finds the interface clean but often unsure if assets were captured correctly — wishes for clearer in-context feedback.

Pain Points

Hasn't earned many rewards — difficulty achieving high enough scores. Wants more variety in reward options.

Key Requests

More guidance for accurate capture · Progress tracker · Leaderboard to compare with other users

U2
User 2 — New to Rewards Apps Casual User ▾
Experience

Found the app in the store. Finds basic capture straightforward, but scoring system is opaque and confusing.

Pain Points

Doesn't understand how scoring works. Difficult to achieve scores high enough for rewards — discouraging.

Key Requests

More transparency around scoring · More frequent low-barrier reward opportunities · Clearer visual prompts

U3
User 3 — Avid Rewards Collector Engaged User ▾
Experience

Actively seeks reward apps. Finds capture easy but sometimes unsure if assets were captured correctly.

Pain Points

Struggles to reach higher-value tiers. Finds navigation unintuitive in certain flows.

Key Requests

Better capture guidance · Progress tracker · More intuitive navigation structure

07 — Empathy Map

Understanding Maria's World

The empathy map consolidated qualitative data from all 3 user interviews and the survey into a unified view of what users say, think, do, and feel while using the app.

08 — User Journey

Maria's Journey with the App

Mapping Maria's day-to-day interaction revealed the key touchpoints, emotions, and friction points across the full reward cycle.

01
Preparing for the Day

Reviews inventory, creates restocking list including cooler beverages — creates the context for app usage.

02
Opening the App

While restocking, opens the app and selects the asset capture option. Follows prompts to ensure clear, accurate photos.

03
Submitting Asset Images

Uploads captured images. Double-checks before finalising — anxiety point due to unclear validation feedback.

04
Reviewing Rewards

Navigates to rewards section to check progress and available incentives — discounts and promotional items.

05
Earning & Redeeming

Receives in-app notification of earned reward. Follows redemption instructions to apply discount at supplier checkout.

06
Reflecting on the Experience

Considers incorporating the app into daily routine — critical retention moment.

01Onboarding Experience▾

Participants found the onboarding intuitive and easy to follow. A few users suggested adding more visual cues or tooltips.

✓ Add contextual tooltips to onboarding
02Asset Capture▾

Users praised its simplicity and effectiveness. Clear prompts helped capture accurately, though some noted image recognition accuracy needed improvement.

✓ Improve image recognition accuracy
03Redeeming Rewards▾

No major issues — the process was straightforward and seamless. Users suggested streamlining reward selection.

✓ Streamline reward selection flow
04Navigation & Usability▾

Navigation found intuitive overall, but a few participants suggested organizing the menu more logically.

✓ Reorganize navigation menu hierarchy
05Notifications▾

Users appreciated notifications but noted occasional delivery delays.

✓ Improve notification delivery reliability
06Profile Management▾

Profile section was easy to use. Users requested additional customization options.

✓ Add notification preference controls
07Search Functionality▾

Search was effective. Users suggested adding filters and sorting to refine results.

✓ Add filters & sort to search
08Camera Functionality▾

No difficulty using the camera. Clear instructions and visual feedback helped users complete capture efficiently.

✓ Maintain current camera UX patterns

13 — Recommendations

Design Recommendations

Based on the full research and testing cycle, six prioritized improvements were proposed to the product team.

🎯

Improve image recognition accuracy to ensure valid asset capture results and reduce resubmissions

🎁

Streamline reward selection and provide clearer information about redemption options and tiers

🧭

Reorganize the navigation menu for improved logical flow and accessibility to key features

🔔

Enhance notification delivery reliability to ensure timely alerts for earned rewards

⚙️

Add customization options for notification settings and account preferences in profile section

🔍

Add filters and sorting options to search results for faster outlet and product discovery

14 — Outcomes

Results

The redesigned app features a clean, clutter-free interface that makes it significantly easier for users to navigate, capture assets, and access rewards — validated through post-launch metrics.

35%
increase in new user adoption from improved onboarding
25%
increase in user retention from personalization options
84%
increase in time spent in-app after redesign

Personalization and customization options — combined with clearer onboarding and a restructured rewards flow — directly drove engagement improvements within the first 30 days post-launch.
